lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the gills; specifically, a vertical column of four primary blobs is located approximately one gill-width behind the fifth gill slit, with adjacent columns forming a staggered rectangular lattice.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly higher pixel intensity are visible, with primary circular blobs centered exactly at the intersections of these vertical bands and horizontal alignment axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, starting above the fourth gill slit and extending posteriorly, defined by a high-luminance upper edge transitioning to a high-contrast shadow region below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high density of smaller, lower-intensity blobs compared to the primary flank constellation, concentrated along its leading edge and distal region.
